title: Survival Create pack
description: A good mod pack for survival with create
body:
# A create mod survival pack
A Fun modpack for a survival world that makes it so you can  
- go Adventuring (with 64 more biomes)
- Build (with a bunch more wood types and blocks includes emi and jei)
- go looting biomes / structures (with a bunch of cool backpacks)
- And CREATE (create good things with the create mod)
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------  
## Q & A 
Q : Can i play it with multiplayer  
A : Yes you can. But i recommend that you use [Essential Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/essential)  

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------  
 ### Known bugs  
 Some times the game will crash when you open it  
     To fix it: Reload the game
